description: External tools required to build + release this repo. The canonical schema lives at socket-wheelhouse/packages/build-infra/lib/external-tools-schema.json (generated from scripts/fleet/lib/external-tools-schema.mts); every fleet repo references it via the $schema field above so validators pick up the single source of truth. Extend the `tools` map with repo-specific entries (e.g. language toolchains for sdxgen, git credential helpers for packageurl-js).

rust.description: The Rust toolchain channel. Installed via setup:rust (rustup + rust-toolchain.toml), not a release-asset download. The derived pin keeps the external-tools version in sync with rust-toolchain.toml so a bump here bumps the pin.
notes: Added for the perry statusline build (perry is Rust+LLVM, needs the toolchain).
The toolchain is installed by setup:rust (rustup reads rust-toolchain.toml). This entry is a declaration + derived pin, not a release-asset download (like git).
